title: One Address, Several Read Models
description: A clinic copies its address into appointment read models for fast display. The source address changes. What must this denormalized design account for?

options.text: Each copy updates automatically because it contains the same text.
options.explanation: Copied values have no automatic relationship to the source. An explicit propagation mechanism is needed.

options.text: Update the source and propagate changes, allowing defined read-model lag.
options.explanation: Denormalization saves read work by creating copies. Change streams or another owner must synchronize them, with a rebuild path and a staleness policy.

options.text: Remove the source so every appointment becomes authoritative.
options.explanation: Multiple authoritative copies make corrections harder and can create contradictory addresses.

options.text: Use a random UUID to make existing copies current.
options.explanation: An ID choice does not propagate changes to duplicated fields.
